==Hair on living creatures==

'''Hair''' is part of the cosmetic layers that any creature can have. It can also have different colors, turning grey or white as creatures age.

==Hair as an item==

'''Hair''' is a byproduct of [[Butcher's shop|butchering]] some animals. It can be spun into [[thread]] at a [[farmer's workshop]]. Hair thread cannot be used to weave [[cloth]], but it can be [[dye]]d and used to [[Suturer|suture]] wounds in a [[hospital]] or bind [[book]]s in a [[craftsdwarf's workshop]].
